(b)(i)1. The work function energy of a clean metal surface is $5.5 \times 10^{-19} \text{J}$.

Electromagnetic radiation of wavelength $280 \text{nm}$ is incident on the metal surface. The metal is in a vacuum.

Calculate:

1. the photon energy

(b)(i)2. 2. the maximum speed $v_{\text{MAX}}$ of the electrons emitted from the surface.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Explain why most of the emitted electrons will have a speed lower than $v_{\text{MAX}}$.
